'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Joe Olson LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)|VB4-L-watchyourstep-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
